title: Envanter sağlığı
description: Stok durumu, yeniden sipariş önerileri ve fazla stok. Yalnızca okunur; onay işlemleri satış panosundaki envanter bölümündedir.

title: Regional sales
description: Revenue and orders by territory and product. No cost or profit figures, so it is the same for a manager and a rep; each sees only their own territories.

title: Sales drill-down
description: Revenue over time that drills from year to month to day, a donut by subcategory and columns by category. Every click filters the rest.

title: Sales overview
description: Revenue, margin and orders by channel, product and territory.
